name: user-switching
description: Instant switching between user accounts in WordPress and WooCommerce.
author: John Blackbourn

scripts.icons: sharp -i .wordpress-org/icon.svg -o .wordpress-org/icon-128x128.png -f png --palette resize 128 128 && sharp -i .wordpress-org/icon.svg -o .wordpress-org/icon-256x256.png -f png --palette resize 256 256
scripts.bump:patch: bump patch --commit 'Version %s.' --tag '%s' user-switching.php package.json package-lock.json readme.txt
scripts.bump:minor: bump minor --commit 'Version %s.' --tag '%s' user-switching.php package.json package-lock.json readme.txt
scripts.bump:major: bump major --commit 'Version %s.' --tag '%s' user-switching.php package.json package-lock.json readme.txt
